name: Uluru
summary: Uluru is the great sandstone monolith at the centre of Australia, sacred to the Anangu people. Watch it change colour at sunrise and sunset, walk the base with an Aboriginal guide, hike the Valley of the Winds at Kata Tjuta and dine under the desert stars.
seasonNote: Winter (May to September) has warm days and cold nights; summer is extremely hot.
arrival: Ayers Rock Airport (Yulara) has flights from Sydney, Melbourne and Alice Springs; the town is 20 minutes from the rock.
gettingAround: Shuttles, tours or a hire car from Yulara; all stays are in the resort town.
cashTip: Cards and tap-to-pay work almost everywhere; cash is rarely needed.
buyTip: Aboriginal art from the Maruku Arts gallery.
